text:
anya: Hey team — AcmeHealth reported their Dedicated pool hours dropped ~3x during a 20m traffic spike and their invoice shows extra hosted usage. They say requests were on dedicated but billing suggests burst/hosted counted. Can we triage?

maria: sorry they're seeing that, can you paste the invoice id and a sample request id? I'll start the support ticket and loop billing. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anya: Invoice #INV-2026-0421-A, sample req id 6d9f2c1a. Customer says this happened right after they enabled an autoscale policy.

jonah: pinging billing — @jonah here. We'll need the metering dump for the window (2026-03-12T15:10..15:30 UTC) and the dedicated pool id. Any chance this was a cross-tenant routing?

anya: pool id ded-prod-us-east-3, metering window attached below (from customer's console).

usage-bot: metering-summary: pool=ded-prod-us-east-3 window=2026-03-12T15:10..15:30 tokens_served=18,200 reserved_hours_consumed=2.8 burst_tokens=12,900 hosted_tokens_billed=12,900

kevin: looking at routing traces now. Quick hypothesis: LB header rewrite may have stripped the `x-rw-pool` header so requests fell back to hosted routing and still hit the dedicated backend (race), which could cause double-counting in two meters. Can anyone share the proxy change log around that time?

maria: customer enabled a HPA autoscale and our ops team deployed a small HAProxy config tweak same minute (15:12 UTC) — attaching deploy-bot entry.

deploy-bot: deploy:haproxy-config v1.29 by ops@infra at 2026-03-12T15:11:52Z — change: remove `preserve_x_forwarded_headers` (reason: normalize client IPs).

kevin: that matches. If the change removed header preservation, `x-rw-pool` used by the edge to mark requests as dedicated could be missing when metering runs, so two systems would attribute the token usage differently. Repro plan: replicate with HAProxy strip + short spike.

jonah: if that repros, billing impact would be double attribution: tokens both counted against customer's reserved pool (because backend tags them) and counted as hosted/burst by edge meter (because header absent at edge). That would show as rapid reserved hour consumption + hosted usage charges.

maria: I reached out to AcmeHealth to confirm timeframe and got a sample request trace where headers differ. Snippet: ```
request-id: 6d9f2c1a
client-ip: 34.82.11.9
x-rw-pool: ded-prod-us-east-3
--> after proxy change (15:13):
request-id: 6d9f2c1a
client-ip: 34.82.11.9
# x-rw-pool header missing
```

kevin: confirmed locally: with header preservation off, edge meter treats it as hosted and backend still logs ded pool usage. Metering job runs at two points and doesn't dedupe. That's the bug.

jonah: OK — billing action: credit hosted charges for the hosted_tokens_billed in that window and restore reserved_hours to expected levels. We need exact numbers per customer to issue credit. maria, can you provide an export with per-req attribution for 15:10..15:20?

maria: on it, grabbing request-level metering and tenant logs now.

anya: customer wants a timeline and a fix. ETA?

kevin: short-term fix: rollback HAProxy change (restore preserve headers) — I'll coordinate with infra to push rollback during low traffic. Medium-term: add dedupe in metering pipeline (idempotent by request-id) and add an alert when same request_id shows up in both hosted and dedicated meters.

maria: infra rolled back the change at 15:28 UTC. Customer reports reserved hours slowly bouncing back in their console. I've sent a draft credit note to billing for review.

jonah: received draft. I'll issue a one-time credit covering hosted token charges for the window and adjust reserved hour accounting. We'll also flag this for financial reconciliation.

kevin: I'll open a follow-up ticket for metering dedupe and add unit tests for header-loss scenarios.

maria: communicated to customer: apology, root cause (proxy header strip), mitigation (rollback + billing credit), and next steps. They want a postmortem once engineering closes the metering fix. :white_check_mark:

anya: thanks all — please add links to the metering export and postmortem when ready. Closing loop with customer now. :pray:
